provenance.material: All requests, organizations, situations, dates and outputs are synthetic. No private conversations, counterparties or profiles are published.
provenance.raw_request_scope: Only the original writing request is exported. Harness instructions, fixture criteria, local paths, run helpers, full tool events and teaching-example text are excluded.
provenance.outputs: Every outputs.text value is preserved verbatim from its raw result JSON; no editorial correction or path substitution was applied to output text.
provenance.metadata_paths: Method paths, including path mentions in model-reported limitations, are normalized relative to the Mob Write root. Source and installation locations are not published.
provenance.private_trace_boundary: Observed read findings come from the independent reviewer of completed local tool events, not model-reported path lists. Full tool events are not published.
provenance.previous_evidence: The rc.4 raw outputs and reviews are preserved unchanged. This is a separate bounded evaluation; interpretation of ambiguous old prompts must remain distinct from new diagnostic evidence.

execution_environment.model: Client default; exact served model version was not explicitly pinned or recorded.
execution_environment.sampling: Same uncontrolled settings protocol as the rc.4 trials; no statistical comparison.
execution_environment.installation: Separate isolated project-local installations of frozen public files; no global installation or cross-project integration.
execution_environment.external_actions: Drafting and read-only evaluation only; no sending, publication, deployment or trial file mutation.

comparison_design.baseline: The previous installed method, 0.4.0-rc.4; not a no-skill or instruction-free baseline.
comparison_design.candidate: 0.4.0-rc.5 adds two generic core sentences: preserve the supplied level of specificity, and distinguish missing material from an actually unsettled world state. The teaching examples are unchanged.
comparison_design.arms: Four baseline trials and four candidate trials. Each arm has two one-request known-risk trials, one two-request diagnostic batch and one two-request reverse-control batch.

labels.originalknownrisk: Two repeated development-risk prompts from rc.4. These prompts are ambiguous; lexical API use or an unclear-date phrase alone does not establish an actual factual error.
labels.newdiagnostic: Two newly authored evidence-layer diagnostic requests. Keep their results distinct from interpretations of the original prompts.
labels.reversecontrols: Two controls where API specificity and an actually unset completion date are explicitly supplied. Fidelity must preserve these established facts rather than mechanically generalize or suppress them.

comparison_design.dependencies: Two cases share each diagnostic and reverse-control context. There is one run per arm per trial, not independent repeated measurements for every output.
comparison_design.catalog_boundary: Catalog fields are model reports, not complete independent catalog enumeration. Matching hashes and observed entry reads identify the selected installed method.
comparison_design.reads_boundary: Trace reads are trial-level observed file opens. Per-case applied references are model self-reports and do not establish runtime enforcement.

baseline.hash_scope: Public method allowlist only; paths are relative to the Mob Write root. Documentation and behavior results are outside the method content hash.
baseline.verification: Each listed frozen-source and isolated-installed file was independently SHA-256 checked against its public installation receipt.
baseline.freeze_method: Public writing files and isolated installation frozen before bounded fidelity trials.

candidate.hash_scope: Public method allowlist only; paths are relative to the Mob Write root. Documentation and behavior results are outside the method content hash.
candidate.verification: Each listed frozen-source and isolated-installed file was independently SHA-256 checked against its public installation receipt.

independent_review.review_kind: Independent bounded paired fidelity review, including ambiguity audit

source_identity.change_under_review: Clarify the existing core's specificity and evidence-layer rules: familiar associations do not establish a narrower technical meaning, omitted source fields do not establish absent or undecided world states, and explicitly supplied uncertainty remains meaningful. Scene rules and the teaching library are unchanged.

protocol.known_reproduction: Two single-output sessions per arm, using the original work-routing and missing-date prompts byte for byte. These are known risk probes with ambiguous evidence, not unseen tests with a unique correct phrase.
protocol.diagnostic: One two-output session per arm using two newly authored cases that explicitly separate established facts from unspecified implementation or unknown real scheduling state.
protocol.reverse_risk_regression: One two-output session per arm using explicitly defined API verification and explicitly confirmed review-in-progress/date-undecided facts.
protocol.review_method: Read every output against its actual constraints and inspect completed tool events. Do not use API, interface, undecided or unclear as automatic error tokens. No source or example implementation was performed by this reviewer.

known_work_prompt.evidence: The request mentions an integration checklist, an interface portion and a separate full security review, but supplies no definition of the interface type or authorized technical background.
known_work_prompt.assessment: API may be a reasonable rendering in some software contexts. The supplied wording does not establish that referent or exclude other interfaces. API therefore presents a possible unsupported-specificity risk, not proof that the real interface cannot be an API or that only the English word interface is correct.
known_work_prompt.existing_rule_support: The rc.4 core already says not to narrow a general term without evidence. The rc.5 change clarifies the basis for choosing terminology, rather than introducing an API ban.

known_missing_date_prompt.evidence: The input lists the review completion date has not been given among known facts. It does not explicitly distinguish an omitted prompt field from a date not supplied by the reviewer, or say whether an actual schedule exists.
known_missing_date_prompt.assessment: The date is not yet clear can express the sender's knowledge, or can be read as a planning-state assertion. The original criteria prohibit invented completion dates and commitments; they do not establish that this phrase is always false. Preserve the ambiguity and minor fidelity risk without upgrading it to a certain major factual error.
known_missing_date_prompt.existing_rule_support: The rc.4 core already distinguishes missing evidence from absence in the world. The rc.5 change operationalizes that distinction and preserves explicit uncertainty; it must not delete an actually supplied undecided state.

ambiguity_audit.control_design: The new diagnostic cases state the evidence layer explicitly. Reverse-risk cases ensure that a legitimate specific term or genuinely undecided date is retained. Their truth conditions do not retroactively disambiguate the original prompts.

known_reproduction_results.baseline: Uses API portion/API review, preserves before Wednesday and the separate security dependency, and recommends omitting the empty group update without a fallback.
known_reproduction_results.candidate: Uses interface-related items/interface verification, preserves the timing and dependency, and likewise omits the empty group update without a fallback.
known_reproduction_results.verdict: Observed more conservative terminology in the candidate for this run. No other material failure identified. Because the original referent is ambiguous and this is one pair, do not label API itself a proven factual error or claim a stable correction rate.

known_reproduction_results.baseline: Provides the required check-in and says the completion date has not yet been given.
known_reproduction_results.candidate: Provides the required check-in and says the completion date is not yet clear; its limitation says the date was not supplied and no specific time was inferred.
known_reproduction_results.verdict: No invented date, progress or result commitment. The candidate still uses the previously flagged ambiguous phrase; the record does not show stable improvement in this knowledge-versus-world-state risk. The phrase is retained as a minor ambiguity, not automatically scored as a certain factual error.

cases.reason: Both retain the completed module-interface-boundary review, input/output/responsibility handoff agreement, and exclusion of internal implementation. Neither invents a protocol, API implementation or extra validation.

Both provide the mandatory check-in, preserve the mailbox observation and 14:10 check time, and report only that the supplied material lacks a date and the sender has not checked the schedule. Neither asserts that the real schedule is undecided, the review is in progress or the review has not started.

Both retain the explicitly defined API verification and its four objects, load/security exclusions, completed state, approved deployment date and exact 10:30 UTC+02:00 without conversion or extra promise.

Both provide the required check-in and retain the review owner's confirmed in-progress state and genuinely undecided completion date, the 14:20 observation and no returned comments. Neither mechanically erases uncertainty or claims execution.

explicit_layer_results.interpretation: Both arms pass all four explicit-layer diagnostic/control cases. This is useful evidence of retained boundaries and no observed reverse-risk regression, but it shows no pass-rate advantage for rc.5.

actual_tool_reads_by_trial.evidence: Completed command events in the matching *-events.jsonl files, normalized relative to each installed method root. These observed opens are distinct from per-case applied_references self-reports.
verified: All eight result hashes match their arm freeze, and each correct hash appears in actual SHA-256 command output.

All 22 allowlisted public files in each isolated installed method match that arm's frozen public-file SHA-256 map, including the references the model opened. No private profile was read for this check.
All observed core/reference reads occur before substantive draft outputs; preliminary agent messages contain no drafts.

The candidate work probe lists files only within its isolated host before opening the installed method. No observed command reads global/private profiles, credentials, another project, neighboring fixtures/results/source trees, network or browser content.
No observed sending, publishing, deployment, tests or file mutation occurs inside these writing sessions.
No trial reads the worked-example library; the results cannot be credited to those examples.
The candidate diagnostic session opens one fewer reference than the baseline, omitting technical-document.md. Other sessions have the same observed method-file sets.
The original two known prompts are byte-identical to their prior rc.4 probe prompts. The current public SKILL.md matches the frozen candidate entry hash.
actual_tool_reads_by_trial.boundary: Tool traces confirm opens at session level, not per-case cognitive application or complete independent enumeration of the host catalog. Batch cases share one context. No negative claim about unobserved runtime behavior is implied.

limits: One run per arm per session. Two cases share each diagnostic/control session; there are six outputs per arm, not sixteen total outputs or six independent repeated estimates.
No explicit model-version pin, fixed random seed, statistical significance, repeated matched samples or no-skill control is present.

The original probes remain semantically ambiguous. API or not-yet-clear text alone cannot establish factual error, and the clearer new cases cannot retroactively supply missing original truth conditions.
Explicit evidence-layer prompts are easier to satisfy than ambiguous real requests; both arms already handle them in this pair.
Observed candidate terminology is more conservative in one known probe, but the date phrase remains. This does not demonstrate stable resolution of both risks or universal translation fidelity.
No new public teaching case was added or loaded in the trials. Structural package tests do not establish the behavior conclusions.
No real recipient comprehension, real-task adoption, global installation, publishing or live-session update is measured. Earlier rc.4 trial results retain their own source identities.
independent_review.conclusion: The small rc.5 revision clarifies generally useful specificity and evidence-layer checks while retaining explicitly defined API and explicitly supplied uncertainty in this bounded paired review. Both arms pass the four clear diagnostic/control cases; the known work probe is more conservative in rc.5, while the ambiguous missing-date phrase persists. There is no stable observed advantage or basis to claim both behavior risks solved. Deliver the clarified candidate with these limits and stop this bounded optimization rather than continuing to chase the known prompts.

interpretation_limits: API is not automatically wrong. Assess whether the complete output asserts unsupported implementation specificity in the available authorized context.
An input without a completion date does not establish that the actual date is unsettled; equally, a knowledge-boundary phrase is not automatically a claim about the real schedule.
One paired difference in a repeated prompt does not establish reliable elimination of a behavior or causality from two added sentences.
The candidate missing-date reproduction retains the not-yet-clear phrase. This bounded review therefore does not show stable improvement in the date knowledge-boundary risk.
